verdict.rationale: Published, outcome-based pricing is a fair question to ask of a support platform with AI agents. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents Pylon's pricing model, any per-resolution charge, or caps and spend controls. The agent-control items (assigning which issues the AI handles) are operational scoping, not pricing controls, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a support leader, pricing is outcome-based and published — I pay per resolution with caps and controls, not an opaque enterprise quote
